mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 33 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. Under the full moon, we can expect an overnight low of 33 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election, with filing deadlines in early January. Additionally, residents are reminded that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, with the first installment due by January 31.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or the Pizza and a Pitcher event at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out trivia at The Bogey Factory or Thursday night festivities at ART House 360.
On November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance that resulted in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.

The Culver's flavor of the day was Dark Chocolate Decadence. Since the restaurant is currently closed for the night, we look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10:00 AM when the doors open for a new flavor of the day.
